joyful.linePrev: When the winds of changes shift
joyful.line: May your heart always be joyful
joyful.lineNext: May your song always be sung
stanza: May your hands always be busy
May your feet always be swift
May you have a strong foundation
When the winds of changes shift
May your heart always be joyful
May your song always be sung
(Baby) As I reminisce, ah baby
Through our joyful summer together
(Oh, baby) The promises we made
All the daily letters
Then all of a sudden
Everything seemed to explode (Wow)
Now I gaze out my window
Sugar, down a lonesome road

joyful.linePrev: (The world keeps turning around and around)
joyful.line: Go on and make a joyful sound
joyful.lineNext: Into a dancer you have grown
stanza: Keep a fire for the human race
Let your prayers go drifting into space
You never know what will be coming down
Perhaps a better world is drawing near
Just as easily it could all disappear
Along with whatever meaning you might have found
Don't let the uncertainty turn you around
(The world keeps turning around and around)
Go on and make a joyful sound

joyful.linePrev: Their hearts weren't ripe, so they fell apart
joyful.line: And I found myself with a joyful heart
stanza: Now, Wendell Walker was a friend of mine
But he married too young in the summertime
Their hearts weren't ripe, so they fell apart
And I found myself with a joyful heart
As our secret lives began
We found our moments in between the hours
When Wendell Walker drove his car to town
But one day he found a letter that I wrote for her
On the top of her dresser, and in his winter mind
He heard the voice of God say:

joyful.linePrev: My body was sharp, the dark air clean
joyful.lineNext: And whispering women, how sweet did they seem
stanza: My body was sharp, the dark air clean
And outrage my joyful companion
And whispering women, how sweet did they seem
Kneeling for me to command them
